# Working for Workers Act, 2023

The Working for Workers Act, 2023 () is an act of the Legislative Assembly of Ontario relating to labour rights.
Provisions
The act modifies the rules around mass layoffs to include remote workers.
The legislation establishes new health and safety protections for workers, including fines for the withholding of passports, and cleaner and women-only washrooms on construction sites. Properly fitting personal protective equipment is also required.
Commencment
The act came into force on October 26, 2023.
